title: Photosynthesis
emblem: a green leaf with a sunlit vein

chapters.title: Inside the Leaf
chapters.narration: Chapter two. अब देखते हैं, leaf के अंदर यह काम कहाँ होता है।

beats.say: तो यह food factory पत्ते के अंदर कहाँ है?

do.draw: A textbook cross-section showing the inside of a green leaf at cellular scale: a large translucent plant cell with a clear cell wall, pale interior, and several small oval green chloroplasts around the edge; crisp shaded shapes, fine sand-colored rims, and a restrained teal glow on the chloroplasts.
do.caption: Where is the food factory?

beats.say: Leaf की cells में छोटे हरे bodies होते हैं, जिन्हें chloroplasts कहते हैं।

do.draw: A richly shaded textbook view of one leaf cell, its translucent wall enclosing a pale interior and multiple small oval green chloroplasts; one chloroplast is enlarged in a subtle inset, with layered internal membranes visible.

picture.draw: A plant cell with several oval green chloroplasts, one chloroplast clearly isolated near the cell edge.

beats.say: Chloroplasts में chlorophyll नाम का green pigment होता है।

do.draw: A close textbook illustration of an oval chloroplast, with stacked thylakoid discs inside and tiny green chlorophyll pigment clusters embedded in their membranes; polished shaded forms and a softly lit scientific-illustration finish.

beats.say: यह red और blue light absorb करता है, और green light reflect करता है; इसलिए पत्ते हमें हरे दिखते हैं।

do.draw: An explanatory leaf-and-light illustration: a vivid green leaf beside a magnified chloroplast membrane containing chlorophyll; red and blue light rays approach and are absorbed at the pigment, while a green ray reflects away toward the viewer. Clear directional arrows, luminous ray colors, and shaded textbook forms.

beats.say: अब raw materials का रास्ता देखो।

do.generate: The underside of a fresh green leaf seen at a shallow angle, with a few tiny pores visible along the surface and the curved leaf edge catching warm light; detailed botanical gouache illustration, dark navy background, no text.
do.caption: Raw materials enter by different routes

beats.say: Carbon dioxide पत्ते के छोटे pores से अंदर आती है; इन pores को stomata कहते हैं, और ये आम तौर पर पत्ते की नीचे वाली side पर होते हैं।

do.draw: A detailed botanical close-up of the underside of a leaf: epidermal cells surround a clearly open stoma formed by two curved guard cells; small carbon-dioxide particles and arrows travel from the surrounding air through the pore into the leaf. Include a subtle inset showing the pore on the lower leaf surface.
do.caption: Air enters through stomata

beats.say: पानी roots से ऊपर पत्ते तक tubes में जाता है।

do.generate: A botanical cutaway of a small green plant from roots to leaf, with blue water droplets rising through fine transparent tubes in the stem and branching into the leaf; crisp shaded educational illustration, dark navy backdrop, no text.

beats.say: इन tubes का नाम xylem है।

do.meaning: Water-carrying tubes that move water from roots up to the leaves

beats.say: तो carbon dioxide हवा से आती है, और पानी roots से ऊपर पहुँचता है।
